defmodule Nebu.Admin.LoginController do @moduledoc """ Minimal admin login page controller (admin-ui-migration, AC3). `/admin/login` renders an SSO login page (the AC3 redirect target for non-admins). `/admin` redirects to `/admin/rooms`. The full OIDC Authorization-Code + PKCE login is owned by `Nebu.Admin.Auth` (go-removal-cleanup — re-implemented in Elixir after the Go gateway was deleted): * `GET /admin/login/start` → `Admin.Auth.login_start/2` (PKCE+state+nonce → IdP) * `GET /admin/callback` → `Admin.Auth.callback/2` (exchange + verify + session mint) * `GET /admin/logout` → `Admin.Auth.logout/2` (clears the session) This controller provides the landing page and delegates the auth legs to `Admin.Auth`. """ use Phoenix.Controller, formats: [:html] import Plug.Conn def root_redirect(conn, _params) do # Land on the Dashboard; the LiveView on_mount bootstrap gate redirects to # /admin/bootstrap if the instance is not yet bootstrapped. conn |> redirect(to: "/admin/dashboard") |> halt() end @doc """ GET /admin/login/start — begins the OIDC Authorization-Code + PKCE login. Delegates to `Nebu.Admin.Auth.login_start/2`, which generates the PKCE verifier/challenge + state + nonce, stashes them in the signed Phoenix session, and 302-redirects to the provider's authorization endpoint. (Previously this 302'd back to the Go gateway, which no longer exists — that produced an infinite redirect loop.) """ def start(conn, params) do Nebu.Admin.Auth.login_start(conn, params) end @doc """ GET /admin/callback — completes the OIDC login (token exchange + verify + session mint). """ def callback(conn, params) do Nebu.Admin.Auth.callback(conn, params) end @doc """ GET /admin/logout — clears the admin session. """ def logout(conn, params) do Nebu.Admin.Auth.logout(conn, params) end @doc """ GET /admin/bootstrap/select-claim — bootstrap-mode claim-selection landing. Delegates to `Nebu.Admin.Auth.select_claim_page/2`. The page is normally rendered inline by the bootstrap-mode OIDC callback; a direct GET bounces back into the wizard (or to /admin/login once bootstrap is complete — AC5). """ def select_claim(conn, params) do Nebu.Admin.Auth.select_claim_page(conn, params) end @doc """ POST /admin/bootstrap/select-claim — completes bootstrap with the chosen admin group claim (Go parity: ClaimSelectionHandler). Delegates to `Nebu.Admin.Auth.bootstrap_confirm_claim/2`. """ def confirm_claim(conn, params) do Nebu.Admin.Auth.bootstrap_confirm_claim(conn, params) end def index(conn, _params) do # Before bootstrap is complete there is no OIDC config, so "Login with SSO" # would fail with 503. Send the operator to the wizard instead. if not Nebu.Admin.Auth.bootstrap_completed?() do conn |> redirect(to: "/admin/bootstrap") |> halt() else conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, login_html()) end end defp login_html do """ Sign in · Nebu Admin

Nebu Admin

Sign in to manage this instance.

Login with SSO
""" end end
